description: Public, deterministic smoke benchmark; not an independent intelligence evaluation.

cases.prompt: Compute 19 + 23. Reply with just the integer.
Compute 144 / 12. Reply with just the integer.
Compute (17 * 4) - 9. Reply with just the integer.
Compute 7 squared minus 5 squared. Reply with just the integer.
What is 15 percent of 200? Reply with just the integer.
Compute the remainder of 43 divided by 6. Reply with just the integer.
Reverse the order of the characters in 'stressed'. Reply with only the reversed word.
Sort the following letters in alphabetical order: d, a, c, b. Reply using the letters joined with no separators.
Convert 'MiXeD' to lowercase ASCII. Reply only with the result.
Which word in this list occurs twice: cedar, maple, birch, cedar, oak? Reply with the word only.
Return the first three letters of 'planetarium'. Reply with only the three letters.
All Zorps are Glips. All Glips are Rets. Are all Zorps Rets? Reply only yes or no.
All roses are plants. Some plants are trees. Does it follow that some roses are trees? Reply only yes or no.
A box contains two red marbles and one blue marble. How many marbles are there? Reply only with the integer.
If it rains, the alarm rings. It rains. Does the alarm ring? Reply only yes or no.
If it rains, the alarm rings. The alarm rings. Is rain logically guaranteed? Reply only yes or no.
Output the uppercase English word for the integer 2. Reply with the word only.
A Python list has elements [5, 8, 13]. What is the element at zero-based index 1? Reply with only the integer.
What ISO date is the day after 2024-02-28? Reply YYYY-MM-DD only.
Given the string 'a:b:c', replace every colon with a hyphen. Reply with just the result.
